caption:
India's Modi government revives plan to expand Parliament

Narendra Modi · Politics

Parliament will hold a special session from Nov 30 to vote on a constitutional amendment adding about 50% more Lower House lawmakers. An earlier attempt to expand the size of India's Parliament was defeated when opposition parties joined forces against it. Bloomberg reported the revival, citing people familiar with the matter.

Reported by The Straits Times; Bloomberg.
